ITEM 1 | Leafy green vegetable, bright to dark green leaves with pale white-green stems, wilted and glossy, moist, clustered in a loose mound about 9 cm by 6 cm at the upper left of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale golden-tan mixed grain or rice-like mass with flecks of green herb and small pinkish-red bits, moist and clumped, sitting in a loose heap about 8 cm by 6 cm near the upper right, about 3 cm tall | 110
ITEM 3 | Piece of light tan, shredded or stringy cooked meat with a fibrous texture, pale cream to golden color, slightly moist, on a bone-like protrusion, about 9 cm long and 4 cm wide, about 3 cm thick, resting on top of the grain mass | 90
ITEM 4 | Rectangular folded flatbread or wrap, golden with browned blisters and dark char spots, topped with melted white cheese showing brown toasted patches and a reddish sauce layer visible at the right edge, about 13 cm by 8 cm and about 2 cm thick, lying along the lower right of the plate | 180
ITEM 5 | Reddish-orange tomato-based sauce visible under and beside the flatbread at its right edge, glossy and moist, spread in a thin layer about 1 cm wide along the edge | 15
